name: Isurugi Chie
source:
She was the president of the Second Literature Club with Kirari, Sarina, and Shikanosuke, and also helped keep their band together. 

After getting held back a year and graduating from the academy, she now has a job as a social worker.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=87]Mangagamer[/url]]
